proof_summary: A modular Fibonacci computation shows that the claimed closed form would make both terms at \(M-1\) and \(M\), where \(M=249580077007\), divisible by \(P=195318521017\). Thus their gcd \(g\ge P>1\); writing the positive terms as \(ga,gb\), the true next term is \(g+a+b<1+ga+gb\), contradicting the claimed additive recurrence at \(M+1\).
